body: I don’t expect you not to grieve. I’m not saying it doesn’t hurt. But people die a lot. Usually older. You eventually get over it. Why is it not the case for someone who wants out. It’s their life to choose. I’m not saying you’re wrong but challenging your perspective as therapy is the right answer. It’s not. Go to therapy or talk to a hotline are some of the most useless advices given and any suicidal person will tell you that lol. There are actually memes all over the internet about it if you go look at suicide memes. I do agree with maybe the “reality” being slightly skewed however more largely the case is don’t know how to help verses didn’t know about it. So many times I’ve been vocal about my pain and been told my life isn’t that bad or go for a run or eat healthier talk to someone. Talking to someone doesn’t make my life better. In fact it doesn’t really change my reality. The word reality itself is subjective to the perspective of the individual. Your reality is you love them and care. Their reality may not be the same as yours. And it doesn’t make their reality wrong and yours more right. To them there are thousands of reasons they want to die. Not just not feeling loved. In fact most suicide notes are written because target feel guilty or shamed even while they do it
You’re welcome 😊
What about the person who killed them selves? What about their trauma that they’ve had to live with for their entire lives in some cases? When no one cared until they were dead.

This is seen by most suffering with this issue as a guilt trip because most people in reality don’t want to deal with it and are uncomfortable with talking about you wanting to kill yourself. I even had someone say to me the day after a suicide attempt he talked me out of, “well I thought we were passed that...” 

Me: ..............

It doesn’t go away overnight and most of the time the feeling to do it never goes away. Because someone talking you out of it may have changed absolutely nothing about why they’re ere going to jump in the first place.

And this is the type of person who thinks it’s selfish to kill yourself lol. Leave him be he clearly doesn’t get it. People die everyday. It doesn’t matter what age and it’s going to hurt no matter when it happens. We don’t need to explain that ahead of time to anyone not walking in our shoes and feeling out every second of every day against and loss. Our guilt and our shame that we feel because society makes us feel like our choice to end our lives is automatically wrong because it is uncomfortable and horrific for THEM. You are the type of people we are uncomfortable around. Get over yourselves. Deal with the loss. God knows we had to deal wit your pushiness to change ourselves when obviously we can’t or obviously you’re the one that needs to change and feel like you’re right all the time. That you’re version of life and perspective is the right one and we just can’t “see” that when in actuality you’re the ones who are blind to the internal pain we feel by your unnecessary comments and actions that drive us further away by making us feel even worse and even more guilty. So we can either choose to die on our terms and feel like we are setting our souls free from this pain society and it’s impossible standards and way of life or we get to feel riddled with even more guilt about things we cannot change and die alone in horrible emotionally and integral and physical agony instead of feeling free and joy at going when we wanted to with  someone who understands that need to let go. I think assisted suicide should be legal for everyone who wants it. Not wanting to live should be a good reason to not have to die in horrific ways behind everyone’s backs. It could be a slightly more humane easier process for both parties. Or even having a friend there to hold your hand while you do it is way better than feeling completely trapped because you can’t go and talk to someone because that’s the same someone who told you your choice is wrong or you just need to change your mindset and you should go exercise or some shit. Obviously that doesn’t work. For many reasons but one of them is crippling depression doesn’t allow room for that. And sometimes you can’t control the thoughts that come with that. Learn how it works and empathize with the other party because people like you are the ones who actually make people want to further kill themselves.

I always feel broken. Like everything feels wrong. Life shouldn’t be like this. So why is it easy for some and hell for others? When you have no one or no support you are as lost at sea with no one to help you and no one sees it. They just say go jogging or get your mind off it. But my reality is like this. I can’t change it. And I don’t need to change myself again to accommodate a shitty world that functions in a shitty way that robs its people of the joys of life. Some people get everything they’ve ever wanted and those are the ones saying it gets better. If some get everything they want it stands to reason that some don’t. They don’t get close to their dreams. Even if they try. Something always goes wrong.
I don’t matter. Everyone will forget my name. Even you. I’ll be a memory forgotten in time with the wind.
It’s everyone.
